sql: select "m"."module_id", "m"."state", "e"."active", "a"."membership_id" from "suite"."module_activations" as "m" inner join "suite"."entitlements" as "e" on "m"."workspace_id" = "e"."workspace_id" and "m"."module_id" = "e"."module_id" left join "suite"."module_assignments" as "a" on "a"."workspace_id" = "m"."workspace_id" and "a"."module_id" = "m"."module_id" and "a"."membership_id" = $1 where "m"."workspace_id" = $2 and "m"."module_id" in ($3, $4)

select "u"."active", "m"."id", "w"."kind", "p"."value" as "policy", (select coalesce(json_agg(agg), '[]') from (select "r"."id", "r"."name", "r"."permissions", "a"."membership_id" from "suite"."roles" as "r" left join "suite"."role_assignments" as "a" on "a"."role_id" = "r"."id" and "a"."workspace_id" = "r"."workspace_id" and "a"."membership_id" = "m"."id" where "r"."workspace_id" = $1) as agg) as "roles" from "suite"."users" as "u" left join "suite"."memberships" as "m" on "m"."user_id" = "u"."id" and "m"."workspace_id" = $2 and "m"."active" = $3 left join "suite"."workspaces" as "w" on "w"."id" = "m"."workspace_id" left join "suite"."platform_settings" as "p" on "p"."workspace_id" = "m"."workspace_id" and "p"."key" = $4 where "u"."id" = $5

with recursive required_modules(module_id) as (
      select $1::text
      union
      select dependency.module_id
      from required_modules required
      join suite.module_releases release on release.module_id = required.module_id
      cross join lateral jsonb_object_keys(release.manifest->'dependencies') dependency(module_id)
    )
    select release.module_id, release.version, release.manifest
    from suite.module_releases release
    join required_modules required on required.module_id = release.module_id

select "module_id", "version", jsonb_build_object(
        'module_id', module_id, 'version', version, 'manifest', manifest,
        'artifact', artifact, 'digest', digest, 'signature', signature, 'key_id', key_id
      )::text as "content" from "suite"."module_releases" where (("module_id" = $1 and "version" = $2) or ("module_id" = $3 and "version" = $4))
select id, data, version from suite.module_records where workspace_id = $1::uuid and module_id = $2 and resource = $3 and archived = false order by id asc limit $4

select "s"."backend_kind", s.server_package::text as "server_package", "s"."state", "s"."staged_at", "p"."status" from "suite"."module_submissions" as "s" inner join "suite"."module_publishers" as "p" on "p"."id" = "s"."publisher_id" where "s"."module_id" = $1 and "s"."version" = $2
start transaction isolation level repeatable read read only

select "u"."id", "u"."name", "u"."email", "u"."email_verified", "u"."active", "s"."csrf_token", "s"."mfa" from "suite"."sessions" as "s" inner join "suite"."users" as "u" on "s"."user_id" = "u"."id" where "s"."token_hash" = $1 and "s"."expires_at" > $2
